critique.evidence: The headline, supporting sentence, tier tabs, stage filter, selected-vector details, and “Continue to scored replay” CTA establish the purpose and next step. However, tablet/mobile open on horizontally clipped vector columns, while the detail panel describes context_manip even though that stage is not visible. The kill-chain changes from a connected flow on desktop to an unexplained numbered grid, underscore-heavy labels reduce readability, and the global header silently clips most destinations at smaller widths. These contradictions make selection state and navigation difficult to understand without explanation.
critique.fix: On tablet/mobile, automatically scroll the atlas to the selected stage and visibly highlight its selected card; preserve a clear directional stage flow or explain the numbered grid. Replace underscores with readable labels, add explicit horizontal-scroll affordances, and use a compact header menu instead of silently clipping navigation.
